UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-scoped Lumia Launcher cloud sync profile and active layout metadata.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this profile.

displayName.description: Display name of the signed-in user (1..100 chars).

deviceModel.description: Android device model name that last synced (1..100 chars).

activeBackupId.description: Optional ID of the latest cloud backup snapshot.

tileCount.description: Number of pinned Live Tiles in the latest synced layout (0..500).

pageCount.description: Number of home pages in the latest synced layout (1..50).

accentColorHex.description: Current Windows 10 Mobile / Material You accent color hex (#RRGGBB).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CloudBackup.title: CloudBackup
CloudBackup.description: Stores a complete cloud backup snapshot of the user's Lumia Launcher home pages, Live Tiles, folders, and settings.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this backup.

deviceName.description: Device name where the backup was created (1..100 chars).

backupPayloadJson.description: Serialized launcher layout & settings snapshot (2..200000 chars).

tileCount.description: Number of pinned Live Tiles stored in this backup (0..500).

pageCount.description: Number of launcher pages stored in this backup (1..50).

accentColorHex.description: Accent color hex code active when this backup was captured (4..16 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document storing cloud sync metadata for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: User-owned cloud backups of Lumia Launcher layouts, Live Tiles, folders, and settings.
